strings.home.faq.title: Questions that matter
strings.home.faq.items.0.q: Is this just a ChatGPT wrapper on my calendar?
strings.home.faq.items.0.a: No. Zero runs specific jobs: defending focus blocks, capturing commitments, and closing out your day. It is not a chat box sitting on top of your schedule.
strings.home.faq.items.1.a: With calendar connected, Zero can read event titles, times, and attendees to find focus windows. With Slack, it can see commitments you make in channels and DMs you authorize. It does NOT scrape your drive or email unless you connect them.
strings.home.faq.items.2.q: Will it send things on my behalf without asking?
strings.home.faq.items.2.a: No. Declines, status changes, and shared notes require your confirmation until you explicitly turn on automation for a specific action.
strings.home.faq.items.3.q: Does my manager see any of this?
strings.home.faq.items.3.a: No. Zero is personal by default. Your focus blocks, recaps, and Slack tracking stay on your account unless you choose to share something.
